integrity: The finite search reconstructs all nonzero length-nine column multisets, uses the published distance necessity and optimum P(4,4)=9, checks four-recoverability by two independent exact predicates, and independently enumerates the full GL(4,2) action.
scientific_limitations: Finite classification only for binary linear information dimension 4, four recovery sets, and optimal length 9.
Equivalence is coordinate permutation plus invertible change of information basis; nonlinear encoders and other parameter pairs are outside scope.
An obscure or unindexed prior finite census cannot be excluded absolutely.
title: Two equality types of optimal dimension-four four-server PIR encoders
